posts.title: Italian Wedding Soup
posts.description: Fun fact, Italian wedding soup is a mistranslation and unrelated to formal weddings. It instead refers to the marriage of "meats and vegetables in the broth" 1 . I feel strongly about attributing sources and authors. Regrettably I transcribed and modified this recipe from an Instagram reel over a year ago and have no hope of finding it again. Thank you chef 🫡! Modifications from original Increase
